text: Not from my seat. A range-top break is a breakout-mode entry, and I have no range-contraction read to back it: bar_range_history NOT_SERVED (C12/C13). My read is a retracement by proxy (C7): W and D hh_hl_3 HH/HL, D dist_to_20bar_high_pct 5.95, and H1 pos_in_day_range_pct 100.0 is one intraday hour, not a turn. I ratify reclaim:ma_20 on H1, WAIT, wrong on a daily close more than 1 ATR under the 20-day average. What would clear me toward the range-top break: a served NR4/NR7 or inside-day read under that range.
